title: feat(plugin-security,plugin-auth,verify,platform-objects)!: a permission-set grant names its set by name — no writer fills permission_set_id (#15204 stage 6b-2-pre)
body:
Part of #15204

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

Stage **6b-2-pre, grant by name** (ADR-0131 D10's first step: every grant names its set, then the id column goes). This PR leaves #15204 open: stage 6b-2 (the seeders), stage 8 / C7b (the `permission_set_id` column and its data) and the rest of the epic remain.

## What changes

`sys_user_permission_set.permission_set` is the grant's one reference to its permission set, by machine name. `permission_set_id` is optional; no writer fills it, and no write derives anything from it.

| Surface | Before | Now |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `objects/sys-user-permission-set.object.ts` | `permission_set_id` required lookup; `permission_set` read-only, derived | `permission_set` required and writable; `permission_set_id` optional ("legacy id"); title reads the name |
| `grant-permission-set-name.ts` | hooks derived the name from the id row, refused a disagreeing name | hooks refuse a non-system write naming a set the security catalog does not hold: `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`, `reference_not_found` at `permission_set` (sibling of `position-catalog-refusal.ts`); a missing name is the engine's `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` / `required` |
| `bootstrap-platform-admin.ts` (promotion) | needed the seeded `admin_full_access` row id | writes `{ permission_set: 'admin_full_access' }`; `findExistingPlatformAdmin` reads by name only |
| `auto-org-admin-grant.ts` | resolved the organization's own row id (per-organization copy under a wall) | writes the name; checks the bound security catalog holds the set; no row read to grant |
| `plugin-auth/auth-manager.ts` (self-registration) | read `sys_permission_set` rows for the id | writes the staged name; admission's catalog + ledger check is the only read |
| `plugin-auth/last-admin-guard.ts` | a write re-pointing the id was read as losing standing | standing rides on the name alone; `permission_set_id` left `GRANT_STANDING_KEYS` |
| `delegated-admin-gate.ts` | an insert / re-point was judged by the id's row name | judged by the written name, against the catalog |
| `cleanup-package-permissions.ts` (uninstall) | revoked grants by the set row's id | revokes grants naming the set, plus legacy grants by id |
| `verify/src/rls.ts` | refused when the boot seeded no row; wrote the row id | writes the name; no row read |
| `platform-objects/pages/sys-user.page.ts` | picker stored the row id (`linkField: permission_set_id`) | picker stores the name (`valueField: 'name'`, `linkField: 'permission_set'`); list shows the name |

**The property 6b-2 needs, pinned:** no grant path needs a `sys_permission_set` row. Fresh-database pins with **zero** rows: the organization-admin reconcile under a wall and under `single` (`grant-permission-set-name.writers.test.ts`, `auto-org-admin-grant.test.ts`), the data door (`grant-permission-set-name.test.ts`), self-registration (`plugin-auth/audience-posture.test.ts`), the verify persona (`verify/rls-persona-grant.test.ts`). The first-platform-admin promotion still runs inside `bootstrapPlatformAdmin`, which seeds rows until 6b-2; its grant is pinned name-only and the holder read is pinned with every row deleted afterwards.

**Restrict-only legacy reach (kept, deliberately).** A grant written before the name column carries only its id until the existing one-time backfill names it (at `kernel:bootstrapped`). These reads reach such a grant through its id **only to restrict**: the platform-admin bootstrap's withheld promotion (leg C, now only when a legacy row exists), the org-admin revoke / superseded-variant sweep / duplicate check, and the uninstall sweep. Nothing confers through the id. They go with the column (C7b). The backfill itself and the D10 reference report are unchanged.

## Not in this stage (measured)

- **`sys_position_permission_set.permission_set_id`** (the junction lookup) stays: since stage 1 it grants nothing; its writers left on this tree are Setup's position page, the app-crm / app-showcase `bind-position-sets.ts`, U2's suggestion accept, and the anchor-binding gate in `security-plugin.ts`. It goes with the junction object in stage 8.
- **`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` (~`:1597`)**: the TSDoc's "Assigned Users" example named `relationshipField=permission_set_id`, which this PR's head refuses. The patch round (the seat's review 6110944288, commit `d453ea50d7`) rewrote it by name (`relationshipField=permission_set`, `relationshipValueField=name`) with a `@objectstack/spec` patch changeset. It is text only, and no generated artifact moved. The same round moved `content/docs/api/error-catalog.mdx`'s dangling-reference example to `sys_user_permission_set.user_id` → `sys_user`. (Updated by the seat.)
- **`suggested-audience-bindings.ts`** untouched (U2's; #22854 landed and is merged into this branch).

## Setup's grant picker and objectui

The picker now **writes the name** with objectstack metadata alone. It still **lists `sys_permission_set` rows**: objectui's `RelatedList` Add picker (pinned `0df67f237c5a`, `packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx`) reads object records only (`add.picker.object` through the data source); C9's registry reads live in the metadata-admin pages, not in this picker. Listing the security catalog needs an objectui change; reported to the seat for objectui#7611.

## Size, tiers and review

- 94 files, 845 additions / 1,867 deletions = **2,712 changed lines** (under 3,000; generated translations and test deletions included; updated by the seat after the patch round).
- **Tier H:** `skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md` is edited — it prescribed writing the record id into `permission_set_id`, which this PR refuses. Readings: that file 216 → 213 lines; the `skills/objectstack-data` package (all `.md`) 3,721 → 3,718.
- A same-head contract-tier review is owed (`Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`); the PM spawns it.
- Changesets: `@objectstack/plugin-security` minor (BREAKING, ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`), `@objectstack/plugin-auth`, `@objectstack/verify`, `@objectstack/platform-objects` patch, and `@objectstack/spec` patch (TSDoc text only).

## Verification (local)

plugin-security and the dogfood files below were re-run on the merged tree (`origin/main` `55382dc02`, U2 included); the other suites ran on this branch before that merge, which brought no change to plugin-auth, verify, platform-objects, plugin-hono-server, plugin-sharing or organizations source (it did touch rest and cli; CI re-runs them).


- Build: closure of `@objectstack/dogfood` (includes all four packages) after the `origin/main` merge.
- `@objectstack/plugin-security` full suite on the merged tree: 196 files, 3,973 passed. `@objectstack/plugin-auth`: 136 files, 2,774 passed. `@objectstack/verify`: 31 files. `@objectstack/platform-objects`: 69 files, 1,083 passed. `@objectstack/rest`: 277 files, 5,454 passed. `plugin-hono-server` 28, `plugin-sharing` 41, `organizations` 12 files green. `@objectstack/cli`: unit tier 281 files, 4,185 passed; integration tier `package-install-local-uninstall-cleanups` 16 passed (it grants the package set by name and proves the uninstall revokes it).
- Dogfood, full: on the first run 235 files passed, 1 was skipped and 11 were red. The 11 red files were fixture grants by id; they were fixed and re-run green (11/11), plus U2's `suggested-binding-acceptance` after the merge. (Count corrected by the seat; the dev's report flagged it.)
- Typecheck: plugin-security, plugin-auth, verify, platform-objects, dogfood, rest, plugin-hono-server, plugin-sharing, organizations, cli: all green.
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: 106 derived families accounted for, 106 run; every one green or re-run green after a fix (`check-system-context-census` row 23c rewritten; `check:query-options-erasure` back at 236 after removing three test casts). Three first runs were prerequisite-blocked (shallow clone, unbuilt dists) and re-measured green after fetching the fixture commit and building.

## Acceptance notes

- **Uniqueness:** the declared unique index still names `(user_id, permission_set_id, organization_id)`. A by-name grant stores NULL there, which SQL keys apart, so two by-name grants of one set to one user in one organization are not refused by the database; every platform writer checks existence by name first. A unique key on the name belongs with the column drop (C7b), which can dedupe the data.
- **Pre-ADR-0113 databases:** a column created `NOT NULL` before protocol 17 for `permission_set_id` would refuse a name-only insert at the driver. ADR-0113's ruling records such databases as not measured to exist; the drift report already offers `relax_not_null` for it.
- **Writing `permission_set_id`** is not refused; it is stored and read by nothing that grants. Refusing it is left to the column's retirement rather than built here.
- Translated labels and help (`zh-CN`, `ja-JP`, `es-ES`) for the two columns were rewritten so they no longer describe the retired derivation.

## 维护者速读（草稿）

**改了什么**：用户↔权限集的直接授权（`sys_user_permission_set`）改为只按权限集的名称记录。所有写授权的地方（首个平台管理员、组织管理员自动授权、自助注册、verify 探针、Setup 用户页的「授予权限集」）都只写名称，不再读 `sys_permission_set` 行去取 id；`permission_set_id` 变为可选，不再被写入或用于推导任何东西。非系统写入若名称不在安全目录中，返回 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED`（`reference_not_found`）。

**为什么改**：ADR-0131 D10 规定先让每条授权按名称引用权限集，再删除 id 列。下一阶段 6b-2 要删除写这些行的种子程序；若授权仍依赖这些行，新库将没有首个平台管理员、墙内没有组织管理员授权、Setup 授权选择器为空。本 PR 让授权路径不再需要这些行。

**风险与代价（含回滚）**：外部调用方若仍只写 `permission_set_id` 会被 400 拒绝（需改写为 `permission_set: '集名'`），changeset 已写明。旧数据的授权仍由已有的一次性回填命名，旧 id 仅用于撤销与去重。数据库层面对按名称的重复授权没有唯一约束，由写入方先查后写。回滚：直接 revert 本 PR，无数据迁移、无列变更。另：改了对外发布的技能文件 `skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md`（原文指导写 id，现已不成立），因此本 PR 为 Tier H。

**席位意见**：

**你要做的**：契约复核（PM 安排）通过后，批准合并（Tier H）。另需决定 Setup 授权选择器何时改为直接列出安全目录（需 objectui 改动）。
